Upright meaning

The Blank Rune is the one that says: not everything can be known right now, and that's okay.

This isn't the universe being awkward with you. It's genuinely saying that what you're asking about is still unfolding — the answer isn't set yet, or it's not something you can control by knowing it in advance.

Your job here is to let go of the need to have it all figured out. Trust that things will become clearer when they're supposed to. Be present, stay open, and stop white-knuckling the outcome.

The answer will come. Just not quite yet.
